description: Réseau vélo Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France. La Région investit 300 millions d’euros dans le VIF (Vélo Île-de-France), un réseau de voies cyclables qui permettra de traverser l’Île-de-France en vélo en toute sécurité. 11 itinéraires, soit 750 km de pistes cyclables, sont en cours de livraison. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Déplacements, Mobilité, Aménagements cyclables, Pistes cyclables, Vélorue. The portal shows 849 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
